notes.title: Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds [Update 2204290]
notes.notes:
Hi otome fans! ːChibi_Hijikataː Some good news: we've updated the build today with the following fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Chinese Language would not display for some users
[*] Added UI buttons to change language on game startup
[/list]

Thank you for your patience through some of these issues. If there are other problems, please continue using our Iffy's Tech Support subforums to search for help and our PC form [url=https://www.ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php] here[/url] to give us feedback directly. 

薄櫻鬼 真改　風之章 [2204290]
本遊戲推出了一個更新。

建置版本說明：
[list]
[*] 已修正部分使用者在進行繁體中文版時遊戲會當機的問題
[*] 已在遊戲啟動中增加可用來變更語言的UI按鈕
[/list]

Have a good one!
-Orion

notes.title: Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds Launches August 24!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30278734/a7d78cf5e50fbab00875b8656a9128856dcfa6ed.png[/img]

Prepare your otome heart! Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds comes to Steam this August 24 with a weeklong 30% discount, Deluxe Pack, and the Winds Treasure Box DLC! Get the Deluxe Bundle or Complete Deluxe Set for even more savings! 

Main game:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/589530/Hakuoki_Kyoto_Winds/ 

Deluxe Pack:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/691140/Hakuoki_Kyoto_Winds_Deluxe_Pack/ 

Winds Treasure Box DLC
http://store.steampowered.com/app/663580/Hakuoki_Kyoto_Winds_Winds_Treasure_Box__DLC/ 

Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds will be available on Steam for $29.99. The weeklong 30% launch discount allows you to purchase it for just $20.99! The Deluxe Bundle (the game + Deluxe Pack items) will be discounted at $27.88 and the Complete Deluxe Set (the game + DLC + Deluxe Pack items) for $30.58 with launch discount!
